item.dc:creator: Demic Story · Instagram
item.description:
🔥 Perfect Incline Smith Machine Bench Press

Your upper chest grows with precision, not random reps.

Set the bench to 30–45°, keep your shoulders retracted, and lower the bar toward your upper chest — not your neck.

💪 For Growth
• 4 sets × 8–12 reps
• 60–90 sec rest
• 2 sec down / 1 sec up
• Controlled stretch + strong squeeze

Train chest 2× per week and keep every rep controlled. 💪

item.dc:creator: Demic Story · Instagram
item.description:
🔥💪 Build a Strong Back with Landmine Rows

Landmine Rows are great for building back thickness, strength, and control.

Focus on:
– Neutral spine
– Stable core
– Pull through the elbows
– Squeeze at the top
– Lower slowly

🧠 SETS / REPS

Muscle Growth: 3–4 sets × 8–12 reps, 2–3x/week
Strength: 4–5 sets × 5–8 reps, 2x/week

Rest: 60–90 sec / 90–120 sec

Quality reps build real muscle.

item.title: ▶ 🔥💪 Cable Overhead Triceps Extension: Complete Setup Guide...
item.dc:creator: Demic Story · Instagram
item.description:
🔥💪 Cable Overhead Triceps Extension: Complete Setup Guide

Your triceps, set up the right way 👇

1️⃣ Set the pulley high
2️⃣ Thumbless grip
3️⃣ Face away from the machine
4️⃣ Glutes against the post
5️⃣ Staggered stance
6️⃣ Hinge forward to about 90°
7️⃣ Elbows tucked in and fixed
8️⃣ Extend by straightening your elbows

🏋️ 3 × 10–12
⏱️ Rest 60 sec between sets
📅 Train 2x per week

💡 Slow stretch, strong squeeze.
